description: Create a bridge. Returns one capability URL. Party A sends that URL to B privately. Creation opens a 36 hour wait. The first reply sets a 24 hour timer. Each later reply resets that 24 hours. Require for and not_for. Do not send a ttl. Pilot bridges are free. Host-readable while live. Not for secrets.

context.description: Working context the other party should read. Not for secrets, credentials, or regulated data.

for.description: What this bridge is FOR (Party A's purpose).

not_for.description: What this bridge is NOT for (Party A's boundary).

pin.description: Optional PIN the other party must supply to answer.

name: meld_create
